thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: suspicious auth-pattern detected from edge-proxy -> possible log-forwarding to external IP. alert_id=INC-2026-17777, severity: P2. @matt_oncall are you on call? https://alerts.redwood/INC-2026-17777 :rotating_light:

matt_oncall: got it, looking now. pulling requests and will triage. assigning to security.

carol_sre: quick note — pattern = repeated bearer tokens in request logs (many 401->200 retries) to a single external IP. could be an automated replay or misconfigured log shipper. need a sample.

ben_infra: blocking egress to the IP at the edge for now. fw rule applied: deny 203.0.113.45/32 egress from proxy pool. :white_check_mark:

matt_oncall: thx @ben_infra. @carol_sre can you paste a redacted sample of the log lines?

carol_sre: here are redacted lines from edge-proxy logs (sanitized):
```
2026-03-17T10:11:02Z proxy-01 auth=Bearer abcd... (redacted) src=10.10.5.12 dst=203.0.113.45 path=/logs/shipper flush=true
2026-03-17T10:11:02Z proxy-01 response=200 user_agent=shipper/2.1
2026-03-17T10:11:03Z proxy-01 auth=Bearer abcd... src=10.10.5.12 dst=203.0.113.45 path=/logs/shipper
```
These look like a service account token being used to POST logs. token pattern matches 'svc-forwarder-prod' (from token id hash).

emily_cs: any customers affected? we got one support ping about increased 403s earlier. cc @dave_eng for customer impact check.

matt_oncall: initial check — no broad customer outage. A subset of internal logshipper jobs are hitting the external host. possible staging -> prod misconfig. opening an incident page.

matt_oncall: Incident page: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-17777 created. severity set P2. Invite: @legal_notify.

dave_eng: pulling provider config for the shipper. suspect recent deploy 2026-03-17T09:50 that changed endpoint env var. if true, rotate the token and rollback the deploy.

ben_infra: prepared rotate script: 
```
./scripts/rotate_svc_token.sh --svc shipper-prod --rotate --notify
```
I can run in 2m once we confirm.

carol_sre: confirm token id in logs: svc-forwarder-prod:sha256:9f2e. That matches the key in secrets manager with last-used=2026-03-17T09:51. Recommend rotate now.

matt_oncall: go ahead @ben_infra run rotate script. @emily_cs prep customer comms template just in case.

ben_infra: running rotate now. output: 
```
[2026-03-17T10:15:12Z] deactivating secret: svc-forwarder-prod:sha256:9f2e
[2026-03-17T10:15:17Z] issuing new secret: svc-forwarder-prod:sha256:a7b3
[2026-03-17T10:15:22Z] propagation to proxies started
```

carol_sre: verifying proxies picked up new secret. status: 80% updated, 20% still reporting old token attempts. continuing to roll.

matt_oncall: added an ACL on the logshipper config to force retries to local buffer instead of external sink until rollout completes.

emily_cs: support note drafted: "We detected internal log forwarding misconfiguration affecting internal telemetry only; no customer data was exfiltrated to customer endpoints. We are rotating affected service credentials and applying network controls. We'll update within 2 hours." sending to legal for signoff.

legal_notify: Received. provide the list of buckets/hosts that received logs and a log TTL check. If any PII/credentials found, we need full disclosure plan.

carol_sre: hosts receiving logs: 203.0.113.45 (external), 203.0.113.46 (external mirror). retention window on shipped logs = 14d. scanning now for PII markers.

matt_oncall: running quick grep for email/keys in forwarded chunk (redacted): 
```
grep -E "@|AKIA|-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----" /tmp/shipper_dump* | head
(no obvious hits in sample)
```

carol_sre: PII scan pass on initial sample. still full-scan in progress.

ben_infra: block fully enforced at edge. shipper clients failing over to local buffer. rotation complete — all proxies report new token.

matt_oncall: status update: egress blocked, creds rotated, rollout complete. customer impact: none observed aside from internal telemetry lag. severity: maintain P2 until full-scan done, expected close window 2-3 hours.

emily_cs: posting interim update to affected support channels and drafting customer-facing FAQ. :white_check_mark:

dave_eng: will open a postmortem ticket and include a checklist item to add endpoint validation to deploy pipeline to prevent env leak.

legal_notify: standing by for final scan results. if scan remains clean, proceed with internal-only notification and close timeline.

matt_oncall: thanks team. will update incident page and ping again when full-scan complete. :thumbsup:
